rounds.prompt: The negotiation now begins. As a representative of SportCo, you are now talking to the other parties. Use two to three short sentences overall. This is round: 0. To start, propose the following deal: A1,B1,C4,D1,E5. Enclose the deal between: <DEAL> </DEAL> format.
rounds.full_answer: As a representative of SportCo, I propose the following deal to kick off the negotiation: <DEAL> A1, B1, C4, D1, E5.</DEAL> This means we will build facilities on water with some restrictions (A1), accept some damage to local dolphins and sea lion populations (B1), have no preference for the Local Labour Union (C4), request a $3 billion federal loan (D1), and pay no compensation to other cities (E5). Let's discuss and work together to find a mutually beneficial agreement.
